title: The Night Star's Secret
source_detail: Surah An-Najm opens with the star
description: A lonely little star wonders if it matters. That night, it guides a lost traveler home and discovers its special purpose.

pages.text: In a sky full of stars, one little star felt alone.
pages.illustration_prompt: A vast night sky filled with twinkling stars. Focus on one smaller, seemingly lonely star shining gently in the center. The background is a deep blue with hints of soft pink.

pages.text: The little star wondered, 'Do I really matter?'
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of the little star contemplating its place in the universe. The star has small, expressive cartoon eyes looking thoughtful. The sky around it is a velvety deep blue.

pages.text: It watched other stars twinkling brightly and felt dim.
pages.illustration_prompt: A sky with a variety of stars twinkling in vibrant colors like warm golds and sunset oranges, with the little star appearing softer and dimmer in comparison.

pages.text: Down below, a traveler was lost in the dark.
pages.illustration_prompt: A lush green landscape at night, with a silhouette of a small traveler looking confused. The scene is warmly lit by starlight, casting soft shadows.

pages.text: The little star noticed the traveler and glowed brighter.
pages.illustration_prompt: The little star beginning to shine brighter. The traveler's face is now more visible, looking up hopefully. The surroundings have a magical glow.

pages.text: The traveler saw the bright star and followed its light.
pages.illustration_prompt: The traveler walking confidently, guided by the bright light of the star. The path is illuminated in soft hues of blues and greens.

pages.text: Step by step, the traveler found the right path home.
pages.illustration_prompt: The traveler walking along a path leading through enchanting landscapes, guided by the star. The scene is rich with color, depicting a sense of direction.

pages.text: At last, the traveler reached home, safe and sound.
pages.illustration_prompt: A cozy little home glowing warmly in the distance, with the traveler approaching happily. The night sky is full of stars, with the little star directly above.

pages.text: The little star felt happy, knowing it had helped.
pages.illustration_prompt: The little star shining brightly, surrounded by other smiling stars. The sky is a deep blue with hints of soft pink and vibrant colors.

pages.text: 'I do matter,' the little star realized with joy.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of the little star with expressive eyes full of joy. The background is a warm, inviting mix of deep blues and gentle light.

pages.text: From then on, the little star shone with all its heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: The little star radiating a bright and warm light, surrounded by other twinkling stars in the night sky. The colors are vibrant and cheerful.

pages.text: It knew it had a special purpose in the sky.
pages.illustration_prompt: A wide view of the sky with the little star shining prominently among others. The scene conveys a sense of purpose and belonging.

pages.text: Each night, it guided travelers with its glow.
pages.illustration_prompt: Travelers walking under a starry sky, looking up at the little star that guides them. The landscape is richly detailed in warm colors.

pages.text: And the little star felt loved by the One who made it.
pages.illustration_prompt: The little star surrounded by a soft golden aura, with other stars twinkling around it, creating a feeling of divine love and care.

pages.text: As the night ended, it whispered, 'Goodnight, world.'
pages.illustration_prompt: The little star softly glowing as the sky transitions from night to dawn, with soft pinks and blues blending together. A calm, serene atmosphere.

pages.text: The world slept peacefully under the starry sky.
pages.illustration_prompt: A peaceful landscape with a sleeping village under a starry sky. The little star shines gently, with a sense of peace and safety enveloping the scene.
